content: Bubbletea v2 (charm.land/bubbletea/v2, v2.0.7 as of Jun 2026) is the recommended Go TUI framework for new projects. Released Feb 23 2026 with breaking changes from v1. Uses Elm MVU architecture (Init/Update/View). v2 ships with the Cursed Renderer (ncurses algorithm, 10x faster), declarative View API (View() returns tea.View struct), progressive keyboard enhancements, built-in color profile auto-detection. Requires Go 1.22+. Windows support: full RGB in Windows Terminal; no SIGWINCH (resize events); mouse works; color auto-detection limited on CMD. Battle-tested via Charm Crush AI agent in production for months before release. Used by NVIDIA, Microsoft Azure, AWS.
